The OCR is kept as made, with line endings normalized. No text was corrected by hand; the loci keep the OCR's readings and say where those differ from the printed page.
scope: The first volume of the first edition entire in the Archive's OCR. The general Einleitung sets aside the biography from Diogenes that the Greek editions printed first, and proposes to restore the natural order (natürliche Folge) of the dialogues, in which each presupposes the effect of the one before. The second edition (1817) is on the Archive as well and is not seated.
verified_loci: the Einleitung opens on Diogenes's life, set before the Greek editions — 'ein so rohes, ohne alles Urtheil zusammenge-'
a natural order and a necessary relation of the dialogues to one another — 'eine natürliche Folge und eine nothwendige Be-'
to restore this natural order, against all previous attempts to arrange the works — 'gen Versuchen zur Anordnung der Platonischen'
why_seated: Schleiermacher made the order of the dialogues a question of one mind's development and put the received life aside to do it. The study reads the Einleitung as the modern founding of the order that later chronologies inherit.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-11-02, of the texts still owed in §5 of the design Legitimately Many (drafts/LEGITIMATELY-MANY-design-2026-11-01.md): "lets prepare that seating, its ea corpora deposit, and its tll spine and card".
